messages.author: 67ad684dbd22de9f
messages.subject: Re: part 5 issues
parts:
Hi Pedro,

no worries, it went well. It is just that it provides results for different combinations of cut-points. In the filename "LAAMBBBVCCC_sleep.TDA5", AA is the cut point for light, BBB for moderate anf CCC for vigorous, D is the window length for sleep detection.

I hope it helps.

Séverine
